metric_interpretation.aggregation: case means/extremes, then equal weight per recorded case
metric_interpretation.missing: missing/non-finite values are counted; never replaced by zero
metric_interpretation.transition_mean_heading_change_deg: signed rotation including intended turn angle; not heading error
metric_interpretation.transition_mean_sustained_tracking_recov: observed sustained recovery within the frozen window; null is unavailable recovery evidence, not zero
metric_interpretation.transition_mean_window_duration_s: measured transition window, distinct from full completion duration
